description: This file defines the AWS Step Functions client class for interacting with the AWS SDK. It primarily consists of method annotations indicating available operations for managing AWS Step Functions resources such as state machines and activities.

classes.name: Aws\Sfn\SfnClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Step Functions, extending the base AWS client to provide methods for managing state machines, activities, and related resources.

methods.name: createActivity
methods.description: Creates a new activity for coordinating tasks in AWS Step Functions.

methods.name: createStateMachine
methods.description: Creates a new state machine in AWS Step Functions.

methods.name: describeStateMachine
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific state machine.

methods.name: startExecution
methods.description: Starts a new execution of a state machine.
